The English pages of this wiki are the reference version. The pages are being translated into '''Spanish''' and '''German''', the other two languages of the openCR interface.

Each translated page is a subpage of the English one, for example [[Glossary/es]] and [[Glossary/de]]. The language bar at the top of a page links its versions. When an English page changes, the passages concerned are marked as outdated in the translations until they are updated. The progress per language is shown on [[Special:LanguageStats/es]] and [[Special:LanguageStats/de]].

== How the translations are made ==
* The translations use the terms that openCR shows in Spanish and German: the names of menus, sections and fields as they appear on the site and in the forms, and the entries of the lists. The address is formal (''usted'', ''Sie'').
* German follows the Duden spelling, for example ''Werkverzeichnis''.
* Mistakes found in the Spanish and German interface while translating are being corrected in openCR itself. Until that correction is published, a few names in the translated pages can differ slightly from what the site shows.
* Forms that exist only in English, such as those for dealers and offers, are quoted with their English names.
